app.tagline: Hire someone nearby in your own language.

login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: We'll send a code to your phone.
login.wrongCode: That phone number or code is wrong.

errors.offline: Can't reach Fixa. Check your connection and try again.
errors.changed: Something changed in the meantime. Refresh and try again.
errors.invalid: Check what you entered and try again.
errors.tooMany: Too many tries today. Try again tomorrow.

translation.unsure: This may not have translated well

trust.title: Trust range
trust.explainer: Built only from confirmed jobs. The range narrows as the record grows.

home.describeJobHint: Say what's wrong in your own words. We'll find someone nearby.
home.nearbyHint: See who does the work around {{suburb}} before you post a job.
home.noJobsBody: Describe what needs fixing, and people nearby can send you quotes.

newJob.title: New job
newJob.subtitle: Your address and number stay hidden until you pick someone.
newJob.describeExample: My geyser is leaking through the ceiling
newJob.licensedOnly: Only licensed providers (the law requires it for some work)
newJob.suggestedUnsure: We're not sure what trade this is — please check.
newJob.directionsHint: Gate code, landmark, which door to use…
newJob.mapHint: Tap the map or drag the pin to where the work is, for example a parent's house or a place you rent out.
newJob.mapLabel: Map: choose where the job is
newJob.locationDenied: We couldn't find your phone's location. Tap the map instead.
newJob.pinFirst: Tap the map to drop a pin.
newJob.placePrivacy: Providers see only the suburb and how far it is until you pick someone.
newJob.placeOutside: Pick a place in South Africa.
newJob.placeFailed: We couldn't look up this place. Try again in a moment.

providers.title: Who can help
providers.subtitle: Ranked by real work, not stars. New people get a fair chance too.
providers.waitingTitle: Quotes come to your job page
providers.waitingBody: People who do this work nearby can see your job and send quotes. You choose from them there.
providers.emptyTitle: Nobody nearby does this work yet
providers.emptyBody: Your job stays open, and anyone new who does this work can still quote.

nearby.title: Who works near you
nearby.subtitle: People doing this work around {{suburb}}. To get quotes, describe your job and we'll ask the ones who fit.
nearby.emptyBody: Try a wider radius, or any language.
nearby.describeHint: We'll show your job to people nearby who can take it, and you choose from their quotes.

job.title: Your job
job.waitingForProvider: Waiting for {{name}} to confirm. Contact details unlock when they do.
job.noQuotesBody: People nearby can see your job. Their quotes show here as they arrive.
job.acceptedBody: Confirm to see the address and phone numbers, or decline if you can't do the job.
job.cancelConfirm: Cancel this job? This can't be undone.
job.moreWork: I did more work for this customer

contact.lockedBody: Phone numbers and the address unlock when the provider confirms the job.

chat.privacyNote: Numbers and addresses stay hidden until the job is confirmed.
chat.emptyBody: Say hello, or ask about the job.
chat.pickThreadBody: Each person who quoted has their own chat. Open one from their quote on your job page.

feed.title: Jobs near you
feed.subtitle: You see the suburb and the problem. Details unlock after you're confirmed.
feed.acceptedNote: A customer accepted your quote. Open the job to confirm it.
feed.emptyBody: Jobs in your trades show here as customers post them.

verifyId.title: Verify your ID
verifyId.subtitle: A checked ID helps customers trust you.
verifyId.consentBody: We check your ID number with Home Affairs through Smile ID. We keep only the result, never your ID details.
verifyId.resultBody: Your badge shows on your profile.
verifyId.numberOk: This number looks right. Date of birth: {{date}}.

reason.length: An SA ID number has 13 digits.
reason.date: The first 6 digits should be your date of birth (YYMMDD).
reason.checksum: There's a typo in this number. Check it against your ID.

verifyId.namesLabel: Your names, as on your ID

result.verified: Home Affairs confirmed who you are.
result.nameMismatch: Home Affairs has this number, but the names don't match. Check the spelling and try again.
result.notFound: Home Affairs couldn't find this number. Your ID number badge stays.

offApp.title: Log a past job
offApp.subtitle: Work you did outside the app counts too.
offApp.smsNoteBody: It counts once they reply YES. We never show their number to anyone.
offApp.sentBody: We sent them an SMS. The job counts on your record once they reply YES.

error.self_confirmation: You can't confirm your own job. Enter your customer's number.
error.invalid_phone: Enter the customer's cellphone number, like 082 123 4567.
error.invalid_date: The date must be in the past, within the last 10 years.
error.duplicate: You already logged a job for this customer on this date.
error.monthly_cap: You've logged the most past jobs allowed this month.
error.customer_busy: This customer got too many requests today. Try again tomorrow.
error.sms_failed: We couldn't text the customer. Try again in a moment.

record.title: My record
record.subtitle: Proof of your work, to share or use for ARPL.
record.arplTarget: of the {{years}} years of experience ARPL asks for
record.verifyCodeHint: Anyone can check your record is genuine
record.noArplTrade: ARPL covers trades with a merSETA toolkit, and yours aren't on the list yet. Your record still counts.
record.pdfDownloaded: Your PDF is downloaded. Anyone can check it with the verify code.
record.linkCopied: Link copied. Paste it into WhatsApp or an SMS.
record.noJobs: There are no confirmed jobs on your record yet. A job counts once its customer confirms it.
record.nudgeTitle: Log work you did outside Fixa
record.nudgeBody: Keep your record up to date. Work you do outside Fixa counts towards your ARPL experience.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This link may be old or mistyped.

lifecycle.arrivedBody: Check in so the customer knows you're on the job.
lifecycle.finishedBody: Tell the customer you're done. They confirm it.
lifecycle.waitingForCustomer: Waiting for the customer to confirm the job is done.
lifecycle.isItDoneBody: Once you confirm, {{name}}'s work counts towards their record.
lifecycle.noShowConfirm: Did {{name}} not turn up? This goes on their record and ends the job.
lifecycle.followUpSoon: In two weeks we'll ask whether the fix is still working.
lifecycle.onMyWayDone: We told the customer you're on the way.

report.title: Report this
report.thanks: Thanks. Our team will look into it.

vouch.title: Say a few words about {{name}}
vouch.hint: Your name isn't shown. Phone numbers and links are hidden.
vouch.label: What was it like?
vouch.alreadyDone: You already vouched for this provider.

install.title: Install Fixa
install.body: Add Fixa to your home screen for quick access and offline use.

camera.title: Take a photo
camera.subtitle: The time and suburb are stamped on the photo. No GPS is saved.
camera.noCameraBody: Your browser or phone doesn't allow camera access from this page.

share.title: Fixa job with {{name}}
share.text: Fixa job details: {{name}} is coming to {{suburb}} on {{time}}.
share.textNoTime: Fixa job details: {{name}} is coming to {{suburb}}.
share.copied: Details copied. Paste them in a message.

inbox.title: Notifications
inbox.emptyBody: New quotes, messages and job updates show up here.
inbox.pushBody: See new quotes and messages even when Fixa is closed.
inbox.pushOn: Notifications are on for this phone.
inbox.pushDenied: Notifications are blocked. Allow them in your browser settings.
inbox.pushUnavailable: This phone can't show notifications from the browser. On an iPhone, add Fixa to your home screen first.
inbox.pushNotSetUp: Notifications aren't set up on this server yet.

safety.title: Safety
safety.intro: Only you see this. The other person is never told.
safety.panicSentTo: Alert sent to {{name}} with your location.
safety.panicSentNoLocation: Alert sent to {{name}}. Your location wasn't available.
safety.panicNoContact: Alert recorded. Add a trusted contact so someone is told next time.
safety.panicNotSent: We couldn't text {{name}}. Send the alert on WhatsApp, or call for help below.
safety.callNow: If you're in danger, call now:
safety.timerBody: If you don't tap “I'm safe” in time, we text your trusted contact.
safety.timerMissed: The timer ran out, so we texted your trusted contact.
safety.timerMissedNoContact: The timer ran out. Add a trusted contact so someone is told next time.
safety.timerMissedNotSent: The timer ran out, but we couldn't text your trusted contact. Send it on WhatsApp.
safety.contactNone: Add someone we can text if you need help.
safety.holdToPanic: Hold for 3 seconds. We text your trusted contact where you are.
safety.areYouOkBody: Your safety timer is up. Tap “I'm safe”, or we'll alert your trusted contact at {{time}}.
safety.timerFromCheckIn: Started when you checked in. It stops when you tap “I've finished the work”.

method.in_app_after: In the app, after the job

methodHint.in_app_after: The full price in Fixa once the customer says it's done.
methodHint.in_app_split: A deposit in Fixa once you confirm, the rest once it's done.
methodHint.cash: Paid to you directly. Fixa doesn't handle cash.

payment.depositTooHigh: A deposit can be at most half the price: {{max}}.
payment.pickOne: Pick at least one way to pay.

plan.cash: {{total}} in cash, straight to the provider. Fixa doesn't handle cash.
plan.in_app_after: {{total}} in the app once the job is done.
plan.in_app_split: {{deposit}} deposit in the app once confirmed, then {{rest}} once it's done.

payment.secureNote: You'll pay on the payment company's own page. Fixa never sees your card.
payment.confirming: Waiting for the payment company to confirm your payment…
payment.changeHint: Nothing changes until the other side agrees.
payment.changeByMe: You asked to change to: {{plan}}. Waiting for an answer.

refund.refund_owed: Refund on its way: the Fixa team will pay it back
refund.under_review: Under review: the job was cancelled after work started, so the Fixa team will decide
